description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of matches across different categories, labeled 0 through 5. The chart contains six slices in total. The slice labeled “0” is light yellow and represents approximately 13.3% (3910) of the total. Adjacent to this is a light green slice labeled “1”, representing 13.8% (4046). A pale blue slice labeled “2” accounts for 22.4% (6583), followed by a light khaki slice labeled “3” representing 6.8% (2002). The slice labeled “4” is a slightly darker khaki color and represents 6.2% (1810), and finally, the slice labeled “5” is a pale blue and represents 10.4% (3043). The largest slice, representing 27.2% (8006), is a light gray color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the total number of matches is indicated as 6 at the top of the chart. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the smallest proportion and increasing to the largest.
